forcedChoices.reason: The text speaks to the reader; the Spanish rules ask for the plural ustedes.
English 'one parent' has no gender; Spanish forces one, so both are named.
Spanish 'endogamia' also means inbreeding, so it is kept for in-marriage only, to keep the two English terms apart.
Spanish has no neutral word for a human 'mongrel' that is not also 'mestizo'; this keeps the three labels distinct.
